name: ThinkRail
description: ThinkRail for PI-Desktop: a spec-graph the agent can read, query and maintain (7 spec_* tools), 10 workflow skills (including the authoring checklist for the family), and a panel with a specs browser.
changelog: 1.5.1: Deliver the standing workflow rule over whichever channel the running host actually reads. PI-Desktop 0.20.x replaced the extension runner, hard-coding `systemPromptOptions` to `{}` and merging only a returned `systemPrompt`, so writing `sections[name]` had become a silent no-op and the router stopped firing while the plugin still loaded. The section channel stays first for hosts that expose a section map; with no map the same rule is appended to the end of the system prompt wrapped in `<pi-thinkrail-workflow>` tags, preserving the host prompt and staying idempotent. Carries over 1.5.0's automatic first-request onboarding, the pre-#485 broad router, specs-before-code lookup, and the approved-design-before-build gate.

en.name: ThinkRail
en.description: ThinkRail for PI-Desktop: a spec-graph the agent can read, query and maintain (7 spec_* tools), 10 workflow skills (including the authoring checklist for the family), and a panel with a specs browser.
en.safetyNotes: Reads and writes project files through the host fs gateway (declared scope: read anywhere in the project, write only .md files and the .thinkrail/ scratch dir, delete only files it wrote, always to the system trash); the host resolves every path against the project of the session that invoked the tool, so the plugin never picks a project itself. Ships ONE agent-process extension (`extensions/workflow-rule.mjs`, declared under contributes.agentExtensions, requires agent.extension): no imports, no filesystem access, no network, small enough to read before enabling. Each turn it delivers one fixed paragraph pointing the agent at the choosing-a-workflow skill, over whichever channel the running host actually reads: (1) on hosts that expose a named prompt-section map (PI-Desktop 0.15.x-0.19.x, and upstream pi), it writes only its own section `pi-thinkrail-workflow` and returns nothing else; (2) on hosts without one (PI-Desktop 0.20.x and newer hard-code an empty options object and read only a returned string), it APPENDS that same paragraph, wrapped in `<pi-thinkrail-workflow>` tags, to the end of the system prompt and returns the combined string. The append is idempotent: a prompt that already contains the block is left untouched, and the host prompt is always preserved rather than replaced. It never sends, reads, or writes anything beyond that text. That module runs inside the agent process with the agent's own tool permissions, so it is NOT covered by the fs gateway above; read it before enabling. Registers 7 agent tools and 10 skills (skills are prose; no code runs from them); sends nothing over the network and reads no credentials.

zh-CN.name: ThinkRail
zh-CN.description: PI-Desktop 版 ThinkRail：agent 可读、可查、可维护的 spec 图（7 个 spec_* 工具）、10 篇工作流技能（含编写工作流技能的清单与元规则），以及一个含 spec 浏览器的面板。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 文件的读写一律走宿主的 fs 网关（已声明的范围：项目内可读，只写 .md 与 .thinkrail/ 草稿目录，只删本插件写过的文件，且删到系统回收站）；宿主按发起调用的会话解析每一个路径，插件自己不判定项目。**附带一个 agent 进程内扩展**（`extensions/workflow-rule.mjs`，声明在 contributes.agentExtensions，需要 agent.extension 权限）：无任何 import、不碰文件系统、不发起网络请求，小到可以在启用前读完。它每轮投递一段固定文字，指向 choosing-a-workflow 技能，走**运行中的宿主实际会读的那条通道**：(1) 宿主提供具名 prompt section 表时（PI-Desktop 0.15.x–0.19.x 与上游 pi），只写自己的 section `pi-thinkrail-workflow`，不返回别的东西；(2) 宿主没有那张表时（PI-Desktop 0.20.x 起把 options 硬编码成空对象、只读返回的字符串），把同一段文字用 `<pi-thinkrail-workflow>` 标签包好**追加**到系统提示末尾，并返回合并后的整条。追加是幂等的：提示里已经有这个块就原样不动，且**始终保留**宿主原有的提示而不是替换它。除这段文字外不发送、不读取、不写入任何东西。该模块运行在 agent 进程内、权限等同于 agent 自身工具，**不受上面那条 fs 网关约束**；启用前请阅读该文件。注册 7 个模型工具与 10 篇技能（技能全是文字说明，不执行任何代码）；不发起任何网络请求，也不读取凭据。

author: andrewliu

agentTools.name: spec_grep
agentTools.description: search the project's spec-graph by content (narrowable by metadata); reach for it before grep/read when exploring or planning. Matches within spec files only (files whose frontmatter carries `id` + `type`), optionally narrowed by type / tag / parent / depends-on. Returns path:line matches with a snippet; read a matched file's body with the normal read tool.

agentTools.name: spec_get
agentTools.description: look up one spec by id: its frontmatter, resolved links, and path (read the body with `read`). Resolves forward and reverse edges across parent / depends-on / references / implements. Returns no prose body.

agentTools.name: spec_graph
agentTools.description: walk a bounded slice of the spec-graph (subtree / ancestors / neighbors) from a node. `subtree` goes down the parent tree, `ancestors` up to the tree root, `neighbors` across a chosen edge and its reverse. Bounded by `depth` (default 1).

agentTools.name: spec_create
agentTools.description: create a new spec file with scaffolded frontmatter (id/type/title/links) and heading stubs. Fails if the file already exists, the id is already in use, or the path is not an indexable root-relative .md path. Edit prose afterward with the write/edit tools.

agentTools.name: spec_update
agentTools.description: edit a spec's frontmatter only (scalar fields + list entries); never its prose. Preserves the file's field order, comments, and non-dialect fields. Prose is edited with the write/edit tools.

agentTools.name: spec_delete
agentTools.description: delete a spec file by id, to the system trash. Other specs may still reference it afterward — run spec_validate to find dangling links.

agentTools.name: spec_validate
agentTools.description: check the spec-graph for dangling links, duplicate ids, and parent cycles.
